This '''[[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]]''' was present on the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Endurance/Legends|''Endurance'']] when [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] [[Sabotage of the Endurance/Legends|infiltrated the ship]] in an attempt to kill [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]. He [[Death/Legends|lost his life]] when he was hit by Boba's [[Tripwire/Legends|booby trap]].<ref name="Death Trap" />

==Biography==
[[File:Blown_up_trooper2.png|thumb|left|200px|The trooper succumbs to his injuries and lies lifeless in Windu's arms]]
After a young Boba Fett planted a [[Laser/Legends|laser]]-trigger motion-activated bomb at the entrance to [[High Jedi General/Legends|High General]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu's]] quarters, this clone trooper prevented the General from entering by informing him that [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Skywalker]] requested his presence. When Windu stated that he would be a moment, the trooper stated that Skywalker's request was for his immediate presence.<ref name="Death Trap" />

Windu placed a [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] in the trooper's hand and asked that it be placed in the general's quarters for him. As the trooper stepped through the door, his ankle set off the laser tripwire and triggered the bomb. Caught in the explosion, the clone was hurled across the corridor and slammed against the bulkhead. After the impact, his limp body slid onto the floor of the wrecked room. When Windu saw the trooper laying on the ground of the smoldering room, he used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to pull the clone through a [[Blast door/Legends|blast door]] and into his arms before the door could close. The trooper's armor was scarred. The clone was limp and slumped forward in Windu's arms as he backed away from the room. Windu removed the trooper's helmet and then lowered him to the ground, supporting the clone's upper body with one arm. He shook the clone's body and repeatedly asked if he was alright. Windu's actions were ultimately in vain as his injuries were too severe, and he soon died in the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master's]] arms.<ref name="Death Trap" />
